diagnosis.summary: Model-blind scripted grasp completed all stages, but NaturalGraspDetector never reached trigger_eligible under live Isaac.
observed_failure_modes: contact remained false across all 260 detector samples despite scripted grasped=true
lift_m stayed near 0 (max ~1.3e-7 m) versus min_lift_m=0.04
relative_drift_m ~0.524 m versus relative_drift_max_m=0.01 because object pose was compared to robot base pose rather than end-effector
grasp_occurred internal latch fired on carrying heuristic but stable carry dwell never started
diagnosis.likely_root_cause: object_kinematic_state() uses world.get_pose('robot') for gripper_x/y/z and object_grabbed() for contact; neither tracks the scripted end-effector grasp in this live stack, so the intervention path is not deliverable as wired.
diagnosis.campaign_implication: Do not burn remaining C1-C8 behavioral budget until object_kinematic_state/contact sources are corrected and this positive control is re-run to trigger_eligible=true.
